galaxy_miner.directAnswer: Use this checklist after a purchase, a break, or a reset when the resource panel behaves differently from what you expected. The figures below describe this build; they are calculation examples rather than measured completion times.
whyItMatters: A producer milestone affects every unit in that tier. At 24 Mining Drones, base output is 48 Stardust/s; the 25th doubles the tier to 100/s. Its added output is 52/s before planet, Dark Matter, technology and Heat Flux multipliers. Check the next unit count before comparing purchases.

Galactic Reset uses current Stardust: floor(5 × sqrt(Stardust / 1 trillion)). It awards 1 Dark Matter at 40 billion, 5 at 1 trillion, and 10 at 4 trillion. Lifetime Stardust in the milestones tracker does not determine this reward. The live reset preview is the final check before confirming.

decisions.action: Check Heat Flux and compare the same Heat state
decisions.reason: The active 2x bonus ends as Heat cools. A lower rate alone does not mean the save lost an upgrade.

decisions.situation: Lifetime total is large but reset reward is small
decisions.action: Read current Stardust and the live Dark Matter preview
decisions.reason: Spent Stardust still contributes to lifetime statistics but is unavailable to the reset calculation.

decisions.action: Check for purchased automatic producers and the saved state
decisions.reason: Manual click power alone does not produce offline Stardust. Credit is capped at 24 hours and depends on saved automation.

starterPlan: For the first upgrade, Laser Drill costs 15 Stardust and adds 1 base output per click; Mining Drone costs 50 and adds 2 base Stardust/s. Choose according to whether you will keep mining or leave the game.

At 10 Drones and no Rovers, the next Drone costs 309 for +2 base Stardust/s, while the first Rover costs 350 for +15/s. With 350 available, the Rover has the shorter incremental payback before bonuses.
Export a portable save code or .scg file from Telemetry & Backup before a reset or device change. Store it outside this browser before clearing site data.
Before confirming Galactic Reset, check what clears: current Stardust, ordinary upgrades, current planet and Heat. Dark Matter, purchased Void Technology and lifetime statistics remain.
galaxy_miner.limits: Galaxy Miner is a browser game, not a cloud service. Progress is stored locally unless you export a portable backup. Offline production is capped and calculated from saved automation state; it is not a hidden background process that runs indefinitely.

mars_colony.directAnswer: Mars Colony Idle is a resource-management simulation rather than a pure clicker. The core challenge is keeping Energy, Food, Oxygen, housing, Minerals, and population growth in balance so that adding one building does not quietly weaken another part of the colony.
whyItMatters: The colony economy is linked. Energy-producing buildings create capacity, while Auto-Excavators, Hydroponics, Oxygenators, and Habitat Modules consume or depend on that capacity. Expanding one system without supporting the others can reduce effective output even when the new building looks useful in isolation.

Life support gives population growth a practical constraint. Food and Oxygen are not decorative counters: reserves determine whether the settlement can sustain expansion. Minerals remain the construction currency, while Credits are a visible economic indicator in the current build rather than a general-purpose spendable resource.

decisions.reason: A new consumer is less useful if the colony cannot supply it consistently.

decisions.action: Stabilize life support before adding housing
decisions.reason: More capacity does not help if the settlement cannot support the population that uses it.
Manual input helps bridge early costs, while automation makes later construction less dependent on constant clicking.

starterPlan: Build a small Energy surplus first so later production buildings have room to operate.
Watch Food and Oxygen together; improving only one life-support resource can still leave population growth constrained by the other.
Use Habitat Modules after life support is stable instead of treating housing capacity as the first bottleneck.
Recheck the whole resource panel after each purchase because a building can change both production and consumption.
mars_colony.limits: Mars Colony is intentionally a compact management simulation. It does not model real Mars engineering, agriculture, or life-support requirements, and its resource values are game mechanics rather than scientific forecasts. Current progress is stored in the browser, so clearing site storage can remove the save.

star_defense.directAnswer: Star Defense is a wave-defense clicker that combines direct fire with automated weapons. The useful decision is how much Scrap to spend on immediate damage versus shields, hull, repairs, and automation before faster or tougher enemies reach the mothership.
whyItMatters: Manual fire gives the player immediate control, but auto-turrets make later waves less dependent on constant clicking. Plasma Cannons improve direct damage, while Alpha Turrets and Missile Batteries add automatic pressure. The mix matters because a run can fail from insufficient sustained damage even when manual burst damage feels strong.

Defense is a separate economy. Void Shield generators, Hull Plating, and repair options protect against sustained enemy pressure. Tactical abilities such as EMP Shock, Rapid Fire, and Nuke are most valuable when used to solve a specific dangerous wave rather than activated as soon as they become available.

decisions.reason: Longer enemy survival increases the time they have to pressure the mothership.

decisions.situation: Hull is dropping despite adequate damage
decisions.action: Invest in shield, hull, or repair
decisions.reason: More offense does not recover survivability that is already failing.

decisions.situation: A boss or dense wave appears
decisions.action: Use a tactical ability for the pressure spike
decisions.reason: Timed abilities are more valuable when they prevent a specific failure than when used without a threat.

starterPlan: Use direct fire to clear early waves while saving enough Scrap for the first durable upgrade.
Add automated damage before manual firing becomes the only way to keep up with wave speed.
Treat survivability as a real upgrade category; a run with high damage can still end if shields and hull lag behind.
Keep one tactical response available for a boss or sudden pressure spike instead of spending every cooldown immediately.
star_defense.limits: Star Defense is a browser arcade simulation. Enemy scaling, weapon behavior, shields, and Scrap are fictional game systems. The mode is designed around its own current wave rules and should not be read as a simulation of real spacecraft combat.

merge_ships.directAnswer: Merge Spaceships combines a finite hangar board with automated orbit combat. The central tradeoff is whether to keep ships in the hangar for future merges or deploy them immediately so they can damage asteroids and generate Credits.
whyItMatters: Board space turns merging into a planning problem. Two matching ships can be fused into a stronger level, but each slot used by an unmerged ship reduces the room available for future combinations. Deploying a ship frees hangar space and creates income, but that unit is no longer available for an immediate merge on the board.

Technology changes the value of both choices. Orbit Expansion creates more deployment room, Advanced Fabrication improves newly acquired ship quality, and Logistics Net affects incoming crate frequency. Because those upgrades alter the flow of ships and Credits, the best hangar strategy changes as the run develops.

decisions.action: Complete a merge or deploy a useful ship
decisions.reason: A full board blocks flexibility and can waste incoming opportunities.
Orbit DPS drives asteroid destruction and therefore Credit generation.

decisions.situation: Purchases create too many weak ships
decisions.reason: Improving the starting level of new ships reduces the number of merge steps needed later.

starterPlan: Keep enough free hangar space to combine matching levels instead of filling every slot immediately.
Deploy ships when the Credit income from orbit is more useful than keeping those ships available for another merge.
Upgrade fabrication when repetitive low-level merges become the main bottleneck.
Use offline income as a convenience, not as a perfect combat simulation; it is an estimate based on the saved deployed fleet.
merge_ships.limits: Offline and background recovery is capped at 24 hours and uses an estimated Orbit-income model rather than simulating every asteroid and projectile while the page is closed. Progress is local to the current browser unless the mode provides an explicit backup feature.

gravity_idle.directAnswer: Gravity Idle is a physics-themed idle game where launchers fire projectiles through a central gravity well. The interesting variable is not raw click speed but how gravity strength, fire rate, projectile damage, and piercing combine to turn moving targets into Matter.
whyItMatters: Changing gravity changes trajectories rather than simply multiplying a score. The Event Horizon upgrade strengthens the central pull, so projectiles curve differently through the play field. Orbital Cannons and Auto-Loader increase projectile frequency, while Kinetic Mass and Quantum Drill affect damage and piercing.

The manual gravity pulse provides a periodic active intervention, but most long-run output comes from the automated launcher system. That makes the mode useful for players who want to watch a system evolve and occasionally intervene rather than repeatedly press a single button.

decisions.action: Compare gravity strength with launcher frequency
decisions.reason: A stronger pull changes paths, but more shots can also improve hit opportunities.
Trajectory alone does not solve insufficient impact damage.
Long-run production depends more on sustained automated interactions than on the manual pulse.

starterPlan: Increase launch frequency enough to create a steady stream of projectiles before over-investing in one damage stat.
Watch how a gravity upgrade changes trajectories; the best value is visual and systemic, not only a larger number.
Use the manual pulse when it can meaningfully alter an active cluster of objects instead of treating it as a spam action.
After a major automation upgrade, reassess whether damage, piercing, or gravity is now the limiting factor.
gravity_idle.limits: Gravity Idle uses simplified game physics and is not an educational orbital-mechanics simulator. Offline Matter recovery is capped at 24 hours and estimated from saved launcher state; the full projectile simulation does not continue offscreen.

deep_signal.directAnswer: Deep Space Signal is an idle scanning and decryption game. Each scan spends Energy to create encrypted transmissions, then the player chooses between manual decryption, passive processing, more Energy infrastructure, automated scanning, and faction analysis.
whyItMatters: Energy is the pacing resource. Capacitor Bank increases maximum Energy, Solar Sails improve regeneration, and Auto-Scan AI can remove part of the manual scanning burden. Crypto Core improves passive decryption, while the Antenna Array increases the Data value of newly scanned signals.

Decoded transmissions are not just score objects. Analyzed messages can advance BIO, TECH, MIL, or VOID progression, and those faction levels feed back into regeneration, decryption speed, scan cost, and Energy capacity. That makes the long-run loop about choosing which supporting system to strengthen next.

decisions.situation: Energy empties before useful scans accumulate
decisions.reason: More scanning speed has little value when the Energy budget cannot support it.

decisions.action: Improve Crypto Core or decrypt manually
decisions.reason: Scanning faster only increases backlog if processing is the true bottleneck.

decisions.action: Use faction analysis to shape the next constraint
decisions.reason: Faction bonuses can change regeneration, decoding, scan cost, or maximum Energy.

starterPlan: Do not buy only scan-related upgrades; keep Energy generation and decryption capacity close enough to prevent a permanent backlog.
Use manual decryption when one nearly finished message blocks useful analysis, then let passive processing handle the rest.
Treat faction analysis as a long-term system choice rather than a cosmetic collection step.
Once Auto-Scan AI is active, watch whether Energy or decryption becomes the new bottleneck and invest there next.
deep_signal.limits: Deep Space Signal is fictional. BIO, TECH, MIL, VOID transmissions and their analysis effects are game systems, not real intercepted communications or scientific signal-processing claims. Progress is stored in the current browser and can be affected by local storage settings.
